---
title: "map_total_tests"
author: "Gianni Ardielli"
output: html_document
---

Goal:
Map 
- amount of tests by function
- percentage of "results the same" and "results correct"
Calculate how much tests are implemented for each function and evaluate if the
tests rely on real(results correct) or fake data(results the same).
This helps to show where more tests should be added.

# Setup

```{r setup}

pacman::p_load(dplyr, tibble, stringr, purrr)

```






# RR

```{r RR pathways}
files <- list.files(
  path = "tests/testthat",
  pattern = "\\.R$",      # nur R-Dateien
  full.names = TRUE       # kompletter Pfad
)

# Function to extract test names from a file
extract_test_names <- function(file_path) {
  
  file_content <- readLines(file_path)
  file_content <- file_content[!grepl("^\\s*#", file_content)]  # remove comments
  
  # Extract test_that descriptions
  test_names <- regmatches(
    file_content,
    gregexpr('testthat::test_that\\("\\K[^"]+(?=", \\{)', 
             file_content, 
             perl = TRUE)
  )
  
  tibble(
    file = basename(file_path),
    test_name = unlist(test_names)
  )
}

# Read all files
all_tests <- map_dfr(files, extract_test_names)

# Categorize tests
results_summary <- all_tests %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      str_detect(test_name, regex("results correct", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results correct",
      str_detect(test_name, regex("results the same", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results the same",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  count(file, category)

results_summary
```
# Transform

```{r Transform}



results_transformed <- results_summary %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = sum(n),
    n_res_correct = sum(n[category == "results correct"]),
    percent_res_correct = round(n_res_correct / n_total * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

results_transformed

```
